The cargo lead on calm handling
This part of the manual describes what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk Operations
Purpose: keep each animal booking clear, safe, and moving without drama.

The desk works as the first control point for companion travel, so staff must check the booking, confirm the animal details, and make sure the passenger has plain guidance before departure. When a traveler arrives with incomplete papers, the desk does not guess, bend rules, or promise a fix that cannot be delivered. Every animal gets patient attention from trained staff, and the tone at the counter stays calm even when the line is ugly and people are impatient.

Use direct language, keep notes clean, and pass along only facts that help the next shift handle the case without confusion. If the animal needs special care, the desk records it in full and alerts the right team right away. If a crate, carrier, or leash looks wrong for the trip, stop the handoff and get a supervisor involved before the animal leaves the desk area. Never leave a pet waiting where noise, heat, or crowding can spike stress. Harley should be treated with the same steady care as any other animal, with no shortcuts and no rough handling.

Passenger updates must stay accurate and simple. If a connection changes, if a document is missing, or if the animal cannot travel as planned, say so early and keep the passenger informed in plain words. Aurelia Skyways depends on the Companion Animal Travel Desk to protect trust, reduce avoidable delays, and keep companion travel dependable from check-in to release.

If the issue is not settled at the desk, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at once.
